memo.headline: Edge Compute behaves as a Voice AI component, not a standalone category; invest it alongside Voice AI.
memo.evidence: Standalone usage is 12.0% of revenue against a 35.0% threshold, and standalone demand share is 10.0% against 15.0%. Only 8 accounts are standalone, so retention figures are thin (37.5% standalone at 12 months versus 78.6% attached, n=14). Standalone win rate is 25.0% on 4 closed deals, versus 72.7% bundled. Self-serve paid conversion within 90 days is 19.4% with voice and 2.4% without, from 120 signups. The demand-share gap is the sensitive check. The data is synthetic. Materially higher standalone usage or demand in larger samples would change the call.
